create.title: Hard-TOP t=1 residual Fejer parity, tangent, gcd, and scale reduction
create.statement_tex: Retain the complete literal Round-164 residual coefficient c_N^rem, zero-extended on a containing interval of M_L asymp L^2 sites, with D_L=sum_N|c_N^rem|^2<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon. For every positive integer R, the exact sliding energy is E_R=R^(-1)sum_s|sum_(0<=j<R)c_(s+j)^rem e(Jsqrt(s+j))|^2=D_L+2Re C_R and |S_(L,1)^rem|^2<=((M_L+R-1)/R)E_R. Splitting every window by absolute site parity gives E_R<=2E_R^(2), where E_R^(2) retains exactly even gaps, with the exact odd-R endpoint weights. At R_0=ceil(L), tangent coordinates a=d'-d and b=m'-m give r=db+am+ab, chi_4(d')chi_4(d)=(-1)^(a/2), O(L^2) atoms in the complete a,b>=0 sector, empty nonpositive sectors, and ab<0 otherwise. With g=(d,d'), the exact rows have fixed character, O(1+g) points, and |C_(R_0,g>=G_0)^rem|<<_epsilon L^3G_0^(-1)X^epsilon, so every fixed-fraction high-g sector is target-safe. The cofactor-gcd rows have product step 2mm'/(m,m') and character sigma_0(-1)^((r mod 2)k), hence frozen character on even shifts, including the squarefree even-even branch. The exact phase derivative ledger gives |Psi'| asymp Jh/L, Psi'' asymp Jh/(sL), and |Psi'''| asymp Jh/(s^2L), but no uniform modulo-one separation; positive second-derivative and absolute-dual-mode placements are adverse only in their stated scope. The residual target follows at the minimal scale from the open even-shift, opposing-displacement, low-g aggregate (165.K17a). Alternatively, at R=M_L, fixed-shift Cauchy pays all r<R_0 within the L^3X^epsilon energy budget and the target follows from the distinct open even medium/long aggregate (165.K26). Neither open aggregate is proved, and no complete residual, full t=1, other channel, hard-TOP parent, smooth packet, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint, M9, bridge, quarter theorem, or exponent conclusion follows.
create.next_action: At the minimal scale, prove (165.K17a) with one outer real part and every literal weight retained; alternatively prove the maximal-scale even medium/long theorem (165.K26). Compare both with a direct scalar route in the scheduled Round-166 full-proof strategy and current-literature review.

update.statement_tex: Let J=sqrt(X), 1<<L<<H<=J^(1/2), and subtract exactly the accepted canonical close-opposite-prime XOR incidence sector from the literal squarefree hard-TOP t=1 scalar. For N=2^nu M_N with M_N odd, retain all odd divisors if no pair is selected and otherwise use rho_N(d)=1-1_(p|d)-1_(q|d)+2 1_(p|d)1_(q|d), so only neither/both incidences remain. The residual sign mass is product_(r|M_N)(1+chi_4(r)) with no pair and zero with a selected pair. For ordered residual divisors, C_j=sum_(i<=j)chi_4(d_i), a_0=a_(r+1)=0, exact Abel gives b_N^rem=-sum_(j=0)^r C_j(a_(j+1)-a_j), hence |b_N^rem|<=(osc C_N/2)sum_j|a_(j+1)-a_j| for the literal real amplitude, including unequal mass and all zero-extension jumps. Its profile variation is O(1). Fixed-modulus four-prime unit-profile controls have L^(2-o(1)) coefficient-uniform positive-transport capacity, so sign balance, monotone transport, cemetery normalization, bounded variation, finite hard faces, and the accepted positive rank-one collar do not prove the target; this is not literal physical lower mass. Extend c_N^rem by zero on an interval of M_L asymp L^2 sites. For every positive integer R, the exact sliding Fejer energy E_R=(1/R)sum_s|sum_(j<R)c_(s+j)^rem e(Jsqrt(s+j))|^2 equals the coefficient diagonal plus 2Re sum_(1<=r<R)(1-r/R)sum_N c_(N+r)^rem conjugate(c_N^rem)e(J(sqrt(N+r)-sqrt(N))), and |S_(L,1)^rem|^2<=((M_L+R-1)/R)E_R. The choice R=ceil(L) is the minimal diagonal-safe scale, not the unique Fejer continuation. The parity, tangent, dual-gcd, strict-sector, and maximal-scale refinements are proved in M9-M2-hard-top-t1-residual-fejer-parity-gcd-scale-reduction, while its two sufficient aggregate estimates (165.K17a) and (165.K26) remain open. No residual target, full t=1 face, remaining channel, hard TOP parent, smooth packet, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, quarter theorem, or exponent follows.

At R_0=ceil(L), prove the even-shift, opposing-displacement, low-character-divisor-gcd aggregate (165.K17a), or at R=M_L prove the even medium/long aggregate (165.K26).
